title: Infected Transfer Station
objectives: When the *dextro* signal is on, route *❶dextro❶* to *dose*. || When the *levo* signal is on, route *❷levo❷* to *dose*. || When the *mixed* signal is on, use the *mixer* to combine *❶dextro❶* and *❷levo❷* and route the *❸mixture❸* to *dose*.
briefing: A harmful infectious agent is present in species populating the transfer station at J9 Takka. Before the Renunciants can enter this station, special targeted medicines must be distributed to each appropriate species type depending on their chirality.
meditation: The *❶dextro❶* species requires *❶dextro❶* medicine. The *❷levo❷* species requires *❷levo❷* medicine. Reflect how medicine must be appropriate not only to the disease, but also the patient.

title: Nonrepeating Crystal Field
objectives: When the *north*, *east*, *south*, or *west* signal turns on, use the *❶prāna❶* supply to ping the corresponding *❶site❶* for a single cycle.
briefing: This area is known to harbor rare nonrepeating crystals. These objects are highly valued for contemplation. Recover nonrepeating crystals for the Renunciants by perceiving signals from the four directions and pinging them when they are perceived.
meditation: Observe in detail the form of a nonrepeating crystal.

title: The Library Planet
objectives: Use *buffers* to stream all incoming data to the *archive*, prioritizing *❶text❶* over *❷notes❷* and *❷notes❷* over the *❸index❸*.
briefing: We have arrived at Nalanda-1, the great library planet. The Renunciants wish to pay homage by mirroring its contents. Because of the large amount of data, the data stream should be managed carefully so that the most important information is prioritized.
meditation: When serially arranged symbols are reproduced as a *❶text❶*, is the original meaning being propagated? Or is something lost?

title: Sister Ship of the U.V.S. Nirmana
objectives: Activate the *form* signal when only *❶form❶* is present. || Activate the *mind* signal when only *❷mind❷* is present. || Activate the *both* signal when both *❶form❶* and *❷mind❷* are present.
briefing: We have encountered our sister ship U.V.S. Nayuta drifting in deep space and have determined that its deep navigator has malfunctioned, with form and mind becoming disconnected. Reconnect its sense-fields, from raw sensation to receiver and interpreter.
meditation: What are the distinctions between *❶form❶*, *❷mind❷*, and the combination of *❶form❶* and *❷mind❷*?

title: Cultural Exchange Nexus
objectives: When the *dose* signal is on, dispense *❸drugs❸* to the different regions of the ambassador's *❸brain❸* as indicated.
briefing: The Sleeping Ambassador has remained dormant for most of the life of the universe inside a special chamber on this ship. We have now reached his destination and it is time to awaken him. The drugs used for this purpose must be introduced to his brain gradually.
meditation: The Sleeping Ambassador will fulfill his purpose after many eons. Did the potential for action reside within him, or was it given to him by an outside force?

title: Negated Civilization
objectives: Use the *negation engine* to change *❶form❶* into *❷mind❷* and *❷mind❷* into *❶form❶*.
briefing: This area of space contained a large negation engine that was turned upon itself, negating its own negations. To negate this, reverse two common attributes of matter so that the tetralemma can be reinstated and causal existence is once again established.
meditation: The negation of non-negation is not enough to establish existence. Why is this so?

title: The Dream-Reality Realm
objectives: Use *buffers* to balance between beliefs in the importance of *❶wealth❶*, *❷fame❷*, or *❸power❸*, releasing them only when all three are present.
briefing: We have entered the Dream-Reality realm, where consciousness creates reality. However, the inhabitants of this area fiercely disagree on the goal of existence, causing our ship's sense-fields to become distorted. Balance the major ideologies so a single one does not dominate.
meditation: Concentrate on methods to purify the sense-fields so that teleological perceptions do not result in inaccurate navigational data.

title: Alien Mining Colony
objectives: Use the *❶prāna❶* and *❷apāna❷* supplies to create both *❶near❶* and *❷far❷* field pulse-waves.
briefing: Small parasitic organisms originating from the mines of Atali-4 were drawn to the U.V.S. Nirmana's vega drive engines and have eaten away at the substrate, slowing the ship's journey. Direct pulses at the correct frequency to shake off these organisms.
meditation: Reflect how the progress of the Renunciants may be affected by external factors, and how the judicious use of *❶prāna❶* can be employed to correct course.

title: Abandoned Transfer Station
objectives: Use the *❶prāna❶* supply to amplify the prāna *❶trace❶* into *❶form❶*.
briefing: We are at Mimohe transfer station. It appears to be empty, but the Renunciants are able to perceive the faint traces of mindforms that used to be present here and which, over time, have dissipated. Recreate these mindforms in order to repopulate the facility.
meditation: Consider how *❶form❶* can be created by *❶prāna❶* and what that implies about *❶form❶*.

title: Ruins of a Lost Civilization
objectives: Using the *sense* input, detect *❷alpha❷* and *❸beta❸* radiation. || Activate the *alpha*, *alpha'*, and *alpha''* signals when *❷alpha❷* radiation is present for at least one, two, and three cycles respectively. || Activate the *beta*, *beta'*, and *beta''* signals when *❸beta❸* radiation is present for at least one, two, and three cycles respectively.
briefing: The Renunciants have detected traces of ancient thought constructs in this area encoded into different values of radioactivity across large metal lattice structures. In order to document these thought constructs for later study, convert the constructs into an abstract symbolic code.
meditation: Is radiation the result of *❷alpha❷* and *❸beta❸* decay, or is decay the result of *❷alpha❷* and *❸beta❸* radiation?

title: Home of the Eternal Society
objectives: Use *buffers* to store *❸solar❸* power. || When the *inner* signal is on, energize the *❸inner❸* shield. || When the *outer* signal is on, energize the *❸outer❸* shield.
briefing: The Eternal Society abides in an ever-repeating cycle of time. Though the shield that protects it decays over outside time, passing ships rebuild it so it can remain undisturbed. The Renunciants request we participate in the ritual by contributing our own repair of the shield.
meditation: Consider how it is possible that a cycle of time designed to be infinite in length can be instantiated inside of a universe with demonstrably finite time.

title: Hostile Alien Homeworld
objectives: When the *fire* signal is on, route *buffered* *❷antimemes❷* back toward the hostile alien beings.
briefing: Hostile alien beings are present in this area and must be incapacitated before the Renunciants can proceed. This process is complicated by the presence of an antimemetic shield. This shielding can be neutralized if it is made to observe its own antimemes.
meditation: When *❷antimemes❷* are made to observe themselves, what exactly is observed? Who or what is doing the observing?

title: Phase-Shifted Transfer Station
objectives: When the *phase* signal is off, route the ship's *❶prāna❶*, *❷apāna❷*, and *❸vyāna❸* supplies to the transfer station. || When the *phase* signal is on, route *❶prāna❶* to *❷apāna❷*, *❷apāna❷*, to *❸vyāna❸*, and *❸vyāna❸* to *❶prāna❶*.
briefing: This important interdimensional message center and transfer station is phase shifted from the U.V.S. Nirmana. Docking cannot occur until the ship's matter component is aligned correctly. The Renunciants request a realignment of the ship.
meditation: The compatibility of matter depends on the alignment of respective energies. Reflect on the various ways that the desynchronization of *phase* has affected your life.

title: Graveyard of the Syghinan Empire
objectives: Use *prāna cleaners* to clean the prāna *❶trace❶* as it passes through the vega drive.
briefing: A multiplanet civilization in this area perished long ago. However, small amounts of its residual prāna remain. The Renunciants have determined that these traces should be cleaned so they do not have unpredictable effects on the current inhabitants.
meditation: Consider the impermanence of the ancient multiplanetary civilization and how the *❶trace❶* of its existence affects the present time.

title: Galactic Barrier
objectives: Use the *❶prāna❶*, *❷apāna❷*, and *❸vyāna❸* supplies to create a *bridge* wave-pattern.
briefing: A previously unknown galactic barrier has been observed here. Ancient records obtained at Nalanda-1 suggest that it can be crossed by matching its unique energy signatures so that the barrier perceives our ship to be part of itself and not an external object.
meditation: For it to function properly, a barrier must enforce a duality between allowed and unallowed objects. How, then, should a barrier classify itself?

title: Endangered Civilization
objectives: Hack the *❷apāna❷* flow of the mahachakra to match the specified pattern.
briefing: A stellar weapon taking the form of a massive spinning wheel, known as a mahachakra, appears to be on course toward a planet that hosts an underdeveloped civilization. The Renunciants ask that you protect this civilization by finding a way to deflect the wheel.
meditation: By performing actions that affect the world around us according to the wills of the Renunciants, are we altering destiny, or fulfilling destiny?

title: Home of the Great Council
objectives: Use the *negation engine* to ensure that *❶canon❶* and *❷heresy❷* are each correct.
briefing: It appears that a schism has formed within the Great Council, with each side calling itself canon and the other heresy. This is a destructive development, so the Renunciants request that you fold reality to ensure that both factions are simultaneously correct.
meditation: Examine the non-dual nature of what is considered *❶canon❶* and what is considered *❷heresy❷*, and how by definition neither can exist without depending upon the existence of the other.

title: Spherical Metabolic Object
objectives: Use the *❸vyāna❸* supply to create a *❸sound❸* wave that is either *high* or *low* frequency depending on which signal is on.
briefing: A local life form known as Spherical Metabolic Object (SMO) is attracted to a neutron star pulse, placing it in danger. The Renunciants request you come to its aid. We will accomplish this by mimicking its calls to create signals that draw its attention away from the star.
meditation: What is the relationship between *❸sound❸*, a sense faculty for *❸sound❸*, and the ability to evaluate *❸sound❸* positively, negatively, or neutrally?

title: Gateway to Tenfold Void
objectives: When the *X*, *Y*, or *Z* signal is on, route a *❶prāna❶* supply to *❶X❶*, *❶Y❶*, or *❶Z❶* accordingly. || When the *X+Y*, *X+Z*, or *Y+Z* signal is on, route both *❶prāna❶* supplies to those outputs.
briefing: Ayatana sense-fields have detected a ship that has prematurely entered tenfold void. In accordance with the law of this region, we must rescue it. We will do this by retrieving the dimension data of the ship from tenfold void and reassembling it in neutral space.
meditation: Explore the characteristics of the *❶X❶*, *❶Y❶*, and *❶Z❶* directions within tenfold void and how their properties differ from neutral space.

title: Devout Transfer Station
objectives: Use *buffers* to store the *words* of *❶prayers❶* and *❸mantras❸*. || When the *amen* signal turns on, release all stored *❶prayers❶* to *❶form❶*. || When the *svāhā* signal turns on, release all stored *❸mantras❸* to *❸form❸*.
briefing: The current transfer station contains a devout population that has expressed a collective wish to pay respects to the Renunciants as we pass through. We should not leave these venerators empty-handed. Transform their expressions into physical form.
meditation: By what method exactly have *❶prayers❶* and *❸mantras❸* been transformed, and who has performed the transformation?

title: Binary Satellite System
objectives: Use the *universal translator* to change *❶light❶* and *❷sound❷* into *❸thought❸*.
briefing: The Renunciants have encountered an alien species with no visual aspect, as well as a counterpart species that has nothing but a visual aspect. Translate both non-visual and only-visual information into a third substrate medium so these two species can communicate.
meditation: Are *❶light❶* and *❷sound❷* truly equivalent to *❸thought❸*? Is there something lost when translating between these sense-objects?

title: Space-Time Anomaly
objectives: Use the *❶prāna❶* and *❷apāna❷* supplies to stitch the conceptual *thread*.
briefing: The Renunciants have perceived a dangerous rupture in the fabric of space-time in this area and have determined that it should be sutured in order to better protect future travelers using this route. To do this, a conceptual thread will be stitched along its length.
meditation: Expound on the ways in which space-time can rupture and what effects these may have on reality as perceived by an observer. Then, visualize how the sutured *thread* repairs it.

title: Distant Transfer Station
objectives: Route *main* to *main* and *backup* to *backup* when both memories are the same.
briefing: The more time and distance between the U.V.S. Nirmana and the center of the universe, the more small errors accumulate in its data banks. This may result in false memories. Using the backup data banks to compare for agreement, purify false memories, and uphold true ones.
meditation: Ensure that your own memories are free of errors as we approach the edge of the universe.

title: Compromised Generation Ship
objectives: Use the *negation engine* to negate *❷incorrect❷* beliefs about what is *❶real❶* and *❶finite❶*.
briefing: A generation ship is experiencing deteriorating conditions due to the spread of extreme worldviews among its residents. These two views are the extreme of nihilism and the extreme of eternalism. The Renunciants should negate these views and restore neutral reality.
meditation: What misperceptions of reality might lead one to *❷incorrect❷* conclusions that the universe is not *❶real❶* or that it is not *❶finite❶*?

title: The Nebula of Re-Observation
objectives: Use the *❶prāna❶*, *❷apāna❷*, and *❸vyāna❸* supplies to imitate *sense* and route it to *mirror*.
briefing: The Renunciants are delayed in their journey through the nebula of re-observation, Nagarahara. Here, it is not possible to observe because re-observation takes place before observation can occur. To open the path forward, mirror the observer until observation is allowed.
meditation: By mirroring *❶prāna❶*, *❷apāna❷*, and *❸vyāna❸*, observation takes place before re-observation. Elucidate in detail what is happening during this process.

title: Holographic Civilization
objectives: Reroute *❶shape❶* to *❶motion❶*,  *❸motion❸* to *❸depth❸*, and *❷depth❷* to *❷shape❷*.
briefing: The Komidai civilization is regarded as a long-established and powerful existence in this area of space. However, the Renunciants have determined that its basis is illusory. Changes to sense-perception will reveal the holographic nature of this civilization.
meditation: Investigate how *❶shape❶*, *❸motion❸*, and *❷depth❷* can combine within the mind to create illusory forms as large and complex as a complete civilization.

title: Final Transfer Station
objectives: Use *buffers* to store and release 48 units of *❸snacks❸*.
briefing: We have arrived at the last operating transfer station before we enter anti-decoherence mode and cross over the edge of the universe. All relevant preparations have been made. The Renunciants have issued one final request: "Get us some snacks."
meditation: Prepare to cross the edge of the universe.

title: The Edge of the Universe
objectives: Use *buffers* to store four units of *mind* information. || Then release that information to *who*, *what*, *where*, and *when* at the same time.
briefing: Anti-decoherence mode is active, but the ship remains in danger of erasure as it weathers extreme conditions. As a safety measure, transcribe the patterns of the Renunciants into buffers in order to preserve their information in case of catastrophic failure.
meditation: Do not meditate as a separate activity from this task.

title: Gateway to Nirodha
objectives: Use the *negation engine* to mirror *❶space❶* and *❶time❶* with *❷anti-space❷* and *❷anti-time❷*.
briefing: We are at the gateway to Nirodha, the end of the universe. As planned, we will use anti-space to collapse space and anti-time to collapse time. This will shut down the vega drive engines, sense-fields, and all other processes of the U.V.S. Nirmana, thus allowing the gate to open.
meditation: There is nothing to meditate upon.

title: The End of the Universe
briefing: The gate to Nirodha is open, but the law of cause and effect prevents us from entering. It is only by refuting and reversing the principle of causality that the ship may proceed. No other actions may take place.  We will not be able to communicate after entering. Therefore, I wanted to say that it was a pleasure traveling with you. Thank you, and goodbye.
